subject: Request: Pilot Fuel Allocation + Security Tagging for CloudSpring Marketplace Trial
messages:
From: Devon Lee <devon@cloudspring.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner request — pilot fuel + security tagging for marketplace listing

Hi Olga,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our marketplace team. We have a promising SI (BrightLayer) that is ready to onboard a 6-week pilot for a mid-sized retail customer in the EU. They want to run a demo + small POC through CloudSpring's marketplace listing that references Redwood as the inference provider.

The SI has requested an additional 30k token-equivalent "pilot fuel" (promo credit) attached to the marketplace listing so they can run the POC without interrupting the buyer's billing. Because the customer is in the EU, they also require security tagging on the trial instance (data residency + audit logging enabled) — CloudSpring needs confirmation that those tags will be applied when the trial spins up from our side.

Can Redwood: 
- Approve a 30k token promotional allocation tied to deal RWI-2483?
- Confirm the trial instance will include the "eu-data-residency" and "audit-logs-on" tags at provisioning?
- Provide an expiration date and any usage guardrails we should pass to the SI?

I attached the allocation worksheet with the requested split (partner: 100%, customer billing: none). Let us know if you need additional paperwork — legal may want a short addendum for the marketplace voucher.

Thanks,
Devon
Partnerships | CloudSpring
partners@cloudspring.io

[Attachment: pilot_allocation_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Lee <devon@cloudspring.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner request — pilot fuel + security tagging for marketplace listing

Thanks Devon — appreciate the context and the worksheet. A few notes from our side: 

1) Pilot credits: 30k tokens is feasible under our partner promo program, but we need a short internal approval (Partner Credits committee) and a usage SLA. I’ll route this to Marissa for operations approval and Jordan for billing linkage to RWI-2483.

2) Security tagging: our provisioning templates support tags. We can ensure eu-data-residency and audit-logs-on are applied, but for the audit-logs retention policy we need to record the desired retention window (90 days by default). Confirm if CloudSpring needs extended retention.

3) Expiration & guardrails: Our standard marketplace vouchers expire in 90 days unless extended by request. We can set hard caps by token count and an auto-block when consumption exceeds threshold percentages. Please confirm if the SI needs a hard stop vs. alerts.

Action items:
- Devon: confirm retention window and whether a hard stop is required.
- Marissa: can you confirm ops side (voucher coding + provisioning tag template) and expected lead time?
- Jordan: please confirm whether the voucher will map to the existing deal (RWI-2483) and which billing code to use.

Olga
Head of Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:33:00 -0700

Hi Devon / Olga,

Jumping in from Ops — we can do the 30k token voucher with these constraints:
- Expiration: 120 days (we're making an exception for EU pilots this quarter).
- Hard stop: yes — voucher will hard-stop at token exhaust. We will also configure notification at 75% usage to both the SI and CloudSpring partnerships.
- Audit log retention: default 90 days; for RWI-2483 we can extend to 180 days but need a signed addendum from CloudSpring confirming responsibility for retention costs.

Lead time: 3 business days once we have signed confirmation and the HubSpot deal linked (please provide the HubSpot deal link). Operationally we'll create a marketplace voucher code scoped to CloudSpring listing and tag the provisioning template with eu-data-residency + audit-logs-on.

I’ve docketed a small ops checklist and stubbed the voucher in our system (no credit allocated yet). Attached is the voucher checklist.

Marissa Cole
Partner Operations
marissa@redwood.ai

[Attachment: voucher_checklist.pdf (2 pages, 8KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0700

Devon — please reply with the HubSpot URL (or confirm the deal id) and the signed addendum for extended retention if you want 180 days. Once we have that, Marissa will finalize the voucher and I’ll trigger the allocation of the 30k token balance.
